requirements_summary: Primary objective: define unambiguous latency SLOs for Dedicated deployment (p50/p95/p99).
Need separate SLOs for streaming (chunked token delivery) vs non-streaming (complete response).
Client-side timing must be captured (end-to-end) and correlated with server-side latency; both perspectives required for SLA negotiation.
Suggested measurement primitives: histogram with exponential buckets, exported via Prometheus/OpenTelemetry; continuous percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and count of timeouts/errors.
Streaming semantics: measure first-byte latency and tail for subsequent chunk latencies; define SLOs like first_byte_p95 < X ms, per_chunk_p99 < Y ms for 95% of requests where streaming used.
Non-streaming semantics: measure server completion latency and client decode time separately; SLO targets vary by model and sequence-length profile (short chat vs long generation).
Define client instrumentation requirements: monotonic clocks, synchronized timezone/offsets, and tracing headers (traceparent) to join traces.
Test methodology: synthetic load tests with realistic token distributions + production shadow traffic sampling; include KV cache warm vs cold scenarios.
Tail-latency mitigation: plan for model fallback routing (smaller quantized variant), autoscaling cushion, and per-request priority lanes.
Reporting needs: daily SLO dashboard, weekly tail-latency drill, and on-demand exportable CSV for legal SLA review.
